# LenderLink docs for LLMs

> Use these files to generate ready-to-run integration code. Do not invent endpoints.

## Primary entry points

- Client agent instructions: /clients/AGENTS.md
- Contributor agent instructions: /contributors/AGENTS.md
- OpenAPI (public contract): /shared/openapi/swagger-public.json

## Shared foundations

- Environments: /shared/environments.md
- Phone normalization: /shared/phone-normalization.md
- Errors: /shared/errors.md

## Client integration

- Getting started: /clients/getting-started.md
- Authentication: /clients/authentication.md
- Scopes and products: /clients/scopes-and-products.md
- Product APIs: /clients/apis/full-response.md, /clients/apis/mega-report.md, /clients/apis/payment-transactions.md, /clients/apis/payment-transactions-by-products.md, /clients/apis/credit-history-aggr.md, /clients/apis/summary.md
- API Call Detail PDF (Hub): /clients/apis/api-call-pdf.md
- Generate a client service: /clients/recipes/generate-client-service.md

## Contributor integration

- Getting started: /contributors/getting-started.md
- Authentication: /contributors/authentication.md
- Person data response (inquiry API): /contributors/person-data-response.md
- Hashing: /contributors/hashing.md
- MSISDN upload: /contributors/msisdn-upload.md
- Generate a contributor service: /contributors/recipes/generate-contributor-uploader.md
